app.title: Federated Gomoku
app.subtitle: Meet across instances, five stones at a time

board.label: 15 by 15 Gomoku board
board.hint: Use arrow keys to move; Space or Enter to place

local.title: Same-device game
local.description: Black moves first. Take turns; the first line of five or more wins.

online.title: Federation room
online.description: Create a public room or enter a room ID shared by another instance.
online.permission: Sign in with federation write and message access to play online.

room.boardLockedHint: The game starts when both players are ready

rules.title: Rules and online play
rules.body: 15×15 freestyle Gomoku with no forbidden moves. Five or more in a row wins. Online moves are validated by the host, while room traffic remains subject to system federation policy and content filters.
